On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Let me analyze this ARC puzzle grid

grid = [
    [0, 3, 3, 8, 3, 0],
    [0, 8, 3, 0, 3, 3],
    [3, 0, 3, 3, 3, 3],
    [3, 0, 3, 3, 3, 8],
    [9, 3, 0, 9, 8, 3],
    [0, 3, 0, 3, 8, 8],
    [3, 8, 0, 3, 3, 0],
    [9, 9, 8, 0, 8, 0]
]

import numpy as np
arr = np.array(grid)
print(f"Grid shape: {arr.shape}")
print(f"Unique values: {np.unique(arr)}")
print(f"Value counts:")
for val in np.unique(arr):
    print(f"  {val}: {np.sum(arr == val)}")

# Find positions of each non-3, non-0 value
print("\n8 positions:", np.argwhere(arr == 8))
print("9 positions:", np.argwhere(arr == 9))
print("0 positions:", np.argwhere(arr == 0))

# Check if there's any symmetry
print("\nHorizontal flip match:", np.array_equal(np.fliplr(grid), np.flipud(grid)))
print("Vertical flip match:", np.array_equal(np.flipud(grid), np.fliplr(grid)))

# Let me check diagonals
diagonal1 = np.diag(arr)
print(f"\nMain diagonal: {diagonal1}")
anti_diag = np.diag(np.fliplr(arr))
print(f"Anti diagonal: {anti_diag}")
